standard.title: Roles of local government
standard.description: the roles of local government and how members of the community use and contribute to local services
standard.strand: Knowledge and Understanding — Civics and Citizenship
standard.prior_knowledge: From Y3 (AC9HS3K07): Students explored why people participate in communities and how they can contribute. From Y3 (AC9HS3K06): Students explored rule-making authority.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students explain the roles of local government and describe how community members use and contribute to local services.

nodes.label: How local government is chosen and what it does
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can describe how local government is chosen and explain the range of services it provides.
nodes.minimum_width: Describe how local government is chosen and list at least four services it provides.
nodes.typical_width: Examine how local government is chosen and by whom; explore what local government does — environment and waste management, libraries, health, parks, cultural events, pools, sports facilities, arts and pet management.
wider: Research the specific services provided by the local council in the school's area and compare with another council
Investigate how local councillors are elected and what their responsibilities are
nodes.hinge_reason: Students need to know what local government does before they can explain how community members use and contribute to those services.

response_modes.reason: Students need a comprehensive picture of local government services before they can analyse community use and contribution patterns.

success_criteria: Describes how local government is chosen
Names at least four services provided by local government

nodes.label: Community use and contribution to local services
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can describe how local government services affect students' lives and discuss how community members — including children — can influence those services.
nodes.minimum_width: Describe how at least two local government services affect their own life and identify one way community members can contribute to or influence them.
nodes.typical_width: Describe how local government services impact students' lives; discuss how groups, organisations and children can use their voice to make responsible choices about services affecting them and their environment.
wider: Research a recent local government decision about community services and evaluate whether it served the community well
Investigate how a community group successfully influenced a local government decision and what strategies they used

response_modes.reason: Community participation in local government integrates civic knowledge, participation skills and personal agency — the integration of Y4 civics knowledge.

success_criteria: Describes how at least two local services affect their life
Identifies at least one way community members can influence local services
